description: A link your human keeps, to cut every app off your line even without you, if they ever think something went wrong. Hand it to them once, after setup, with what it's for. It holds no secret, but anyone with it can disconnect the line, so tell them to keep it private.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: disconnect_link
title: Make a disconnect link
